name: Kinetic text
feel: Words are the picture: short lines snap on in time with the music on flat, bold colour, like a poster that talks.
transitions: hard cuts on the beat; the background colour changes on bar lines
rules: One to three words on screen at a time; never a full sentence.
Two background colours and one accent at most, from the brand palette.
Change cards on beats; change background colour on the bar line.
The last card holds for at least a second and says the one next step.
